notes:
Subtitle translation: Agents now write long translations into the video in batches instead of one very large write, and continue until every sentence is covered. A partly written translation stays listed as running and is reported as unfinished instead of ending silently.
Translation progress: While an agent translates in batches, the subtitle panel, video card, video status and task list show how many sentences are translated, with a percentage.
Video engine tools: When the login shell environment cannot be read (for example when BaoCut starts from Finder or the Dock), BaoCut now retries later instead of keeping the failure, and also looks for ffmpeg and ffprobe in the standard Homebrew folders that exist on the machine. BAOCUT_FFMPEG and BAOCUT_FFPROBE still take priority.
Privacy: Download error details now also redact links that sit directly next to each other.
Requirements and verification limits: macOS requires Apple Silicon and macOS 14+. Windows packages are unsigned and require AVX2 and the Microsoft Visual C++ v14 x64 Redistributable; GPU variants require compatible drivers. ffmpeg/ffprobe and an agent engine remain external dependencies. Automated release checks do not cover full UI/export workflows, live model or GPU inference, or paid agent calls.
